Классический индикатор Баффетта: капитал: The classic Buffett indicator: total market capitalisation to GDP. Shows whether the market is expensive relative to what the economy actually produces. Judge under- or overvaluation in the context of a specific period: look at recent historical episodes where the context is still relevant. GDP changes slowly, so this is about the long-term picture.
Капитализация к денежной массе M2 (налич: Market capitalisation to the M2 money supply (cash and deposits): how much money there is in the country relative to the equity market. Low readings mean there is plenty of money, but it is not flowing into equities — it sits in deposits and OFZ bonds. M2 is sensitive to central bank and fiscal actions, so it reacts faster to monetary conditions.

Может указывать на то, что денег в стран: May indicate that there is plenty of money in the country, but it is parked in safe assets (deposits, bonds). Common at high rates and in cautious sentiment.
Если Кап / ВВП в норме, а Кап / M2 высок: If Cap / GDP is normal but Cap / M2 is high, households may have little spare cash and the market rally can be liquidity-constrained. If the opposite, the economy appears to be catching up with the market.

«Объём торгов» и изменения м/м и г/г: “Trading volume” and the m/m and y/y changes
Внизу подсказки — «Объём торгов» периода: At the bottom of the tooltip — the period's “Trading volume”: since purchases always equal sales, a plain net total would be zero, so volume (how much money changed hands) is shown instead. Next to it — the change in that volume versus the previous period (m/m for months, q/q for quarters) and versus the same period a year ago (y/y). A green percentage is growth, red is decline, “—” if there is no period to compare with.
Абсолютные суммы важны, но ещё важнее —: Absolute amounts matter, but what matters more is where different groups lean relative to each other. When one category is buying heavily while another is selling just as heavily, it often signals a shift in market sentiment.
Отдельные разовые операции могут искажат: Individual one-off transactions can distort the picture, especially for non-residents, so read the figures as a tendency rather than a precise total.
Данные носят справочный характер и не яв: The data is for reference only and is not a trading recommendation. It shows historical patterns in the behaviour of participant groups, but does not guarantee future moves.
У каждой категории свой «характер». Сцен: Each category has its own “character”. The scenarios below are not buy or sell signals, but typical readings that should be checked against the whole market picture.
Корпорации, фонды, банки — обычно участн: Corporates, funds, banks — usually participants with a long horizon and large size. Their heavy buying sometimes precedes a rally, but not always.
Розничные инвесторы иногда заходят ближе: Retail investors sometimes come in closer to the end of a trend. Buying can cluster near local highs, but that is only one possible reading.
Иногда совпадает с близостью локального: Sometimes coincides with a local bottom being near: loss-cutting out of fear of further declines. An observation, not a rule.
Возвращение иностранного капитала. Замет: Foreign capital returning. A notable positive shift, especially if the rouble is strengthening at the same time.
Отток капитала. Часто связан с геополити: Capital outflow. Often linked to geopolitics, rating changes or currency pressure.
Банки активны на покупке: Banks active on the buy side
Профессиональные участники, которые обыч: Professional participants who usually react to rate and regulatory changes before others. Sometimes ahead of retail.

Первый переключатель выбирает список бум: The first toggle selects the list of stocks for the calculation. “IMOEX index” (“RTSI index” in USD mode) counts only the largest companies in the index — the breadth of the main index itself. “100 stocks” takes a wider list of liquid Moscow Exchange stocks — broader coverage, a fuller picture of overall market sentiment.
Второй переключатель — валюта, в которой: The second toggle is the currency in which prices are taken. In roubles (₽, default) the upper chart is the IMOEX index. In dollars ($) prices are converted, and the upper chart becomes the RTSI index — this removes the exchange-rate effect and shows real market strength in dollars. On days when the dollar index does not trade, a red “USD not updated” badge may appear on the corner of the $ button — click it for an explanation.
Выпадающий список задаёт длину средней л: The dropdown sets the length of the moving average — over how many days each stock's price is smoothed. A short one (20–50) reacts quickly and is sensitive to fresh news — breadth is jumpy. A long one (100–200) shows the long-term trend and ignores short swings — breadth is calmer. Default is 200 days.
Горизонтальный ряд справа — сколько исто: The row on the right sets how much history the chart shows: the last year, five years or the full available history. It does not affect the current value — only the length of the visible range. Some periods and universes may require a paid plan — then the button shows a lock.
Переключатель «Индекс» показывает или ск: The “Index” toggle shows or hides the upper price chart — with breadth alone, its chart stretches to full height. The “Histogram” toggle changes the lower chart's style: bars instead of a line (see “Chart modes” below).

Широкий рост — почти все акции выше свое: Broad advance — almost every stock is above its average. The move is supported by the majority; the base is solid.
Нейтрально-позитивная зона. Большинство: Neutral-to-positive zone. Most stocks are up, but without euphoria. Typical of a calmly rising market.
Слабость или коррекция. Меньшая часть ак: Weakness or correction. A minority of stocks are above their average — could be the start of a decline or just a pause.
Широкая распродажа: падает большинство б: Broad sell-off: most stocks are falling. This state is sometimes described as “oversold”.
Расхождение: индекс тащат единицы, широк: Divergence: a few names drag the index while the broad market is weak. The advance rests on a narrower base — worth paying attention to.
Большинство акций уже подрастают, а инде: Most stocks are already ticking up while the index lags. This sometimes coincides with a change in direction, especially after a long decline.
Сила по короткой средней (20–50) выросла: Breadth on the short average (20–50) has risen while on the long one (200) it is still low — the recovery is fresh and not yet confirmed by the long-term trend. And vice versa.
